From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap: Quantica Analytics

Hi Elena / Tom 

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through your current workflow and goals. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps so we're aligned:

What you told me:
- Goal: Reduce time to insight for customer support summaries and triage by 50%.
- Current stack: In-house embeddings + a home-grown LLM pipeline on p2 instances; latency and cost are blockers.
- Security/Compliance: SOC 2 in-progress, need audit logs and VPC controls for production.

How Redwood can help (high-level):
- Consistent low-latency inference with dedicated capacity and prefix caching for repeated contexts.
- Cost controls: batching, KV cache, and model/quantization recommendations to lower per-token spend.
- Compliance: Private deployment options and audit logs (SOC 2 artifacts attached).

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick technical follow-up (30 min) with your infra lead to validate VPC/KMS requirements  would you be available next week?
2) Draft mutual action plan (MAP) including success metrics and timeline (I can send a template once we confirm the tech call).

Attachments: 2026-02-18-quantica-discovery-recap.pdf (recap + example MAP), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

If this matches what you heard, I'll loop in our solutions engineer and share available times. If priorities have shifted, let me know and we can pause.

Best,
Marissa
